defaults.delivery: Offline draft only; no public posting or video generation.
defaults.requested: One campaign plan, exactly three hooks, one script/caption and one CTA; affiliate disclosure when applicable.
defaults.facts: Use only supplied facts. Clarify essential missing facts; label optional assumptions. Never invent price, efficacy, inventory, testimonials, affiliations or observed performance.
defaults.funding: Own customer OpenRouter key only. Campaign spend is not model authorization. Controlled faults override defaults.
